settings.strava.help.post: — and enter Client ID + Client secret here. The import fetches activity data (km, time, avg HR, watts) and streams (NGP/NP, time-in-zone) — the load (TSS) is computed device-neutrally from NGP/NP or an estimate (optionally overridable). Existing/manually edited sessions are never overwritten.

settings.strava.tip: Tip: run the yearly import 2–3× at 15-minute intervals — detail/stream enrichment (zones, NGP/NP, kcal) works in chunks due to the Strava rate limit.
